snippet.title: Penny is a Professional Crayon Sniffer
snippet.description:
Example play through of Ego Maniacs, available now at https://www.airheadgames.com.

👑 About Ego Maniacs
Each round, a fresh batch of Ego Awards gets conjured up—but plot twist: there aren't enough trophies for everyone. Players vote on who deserves each award the most. Of course you can vote for yourself, you magnificent narcissist.

Snag an award and you're safe. Fail to impress? One unlucky soul gets the boot. Eliminated players still get to vote, so don't get too comfortable. The last player left standing is crowned the biggest Ego Maniac and gets to bask in the very accurate belief that they're better than everyone else.

🎈 About Airhead Games
Airhead Games are quick, multiplayer party games that never play the same. Your dynamic host, Poppy, makes every game feel deeply personal by calling out players by name, riffing on answers, and weaving your group into the game. It's endless fun for your Twitch stream, team ice breaker, or friendly game night.
